searchText: We’re actually running 1.15.5 which made Geth happy again. But we’re now running back into memory issues in Prysm again and constant restarts. <@476250636548308992> or anyone - is there any documentation or notes on resource/memory requirements for running the holesky rescue version of Prysm? Think we’re under allocated, but don’t know where we should be targeting The network has finalized, so what you were using previously should be enough now. Are you fully synced at the time of the restart ? How much memory is allocated to prysm and if you are running any special flags
